title: Moment — Photography as a Craft
description: Initiated the project and shipped a responsive homepage for Moment, fusing Tailwind-driven layouts, scroll-triggered reveals, and a Supabase waitlist API to onboard photographers into the curated story platform.

title: Energy-Efficient Deep Learning using ISP and QLoRA
description: Developed a sequential pipeline combining Instant Soup Pruning (ISP) and Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) to optimize LLMs for efficiency. Achieved 30% parameter reduction, 69% memory savings, and 32% faster inference on the Gemma-3-1B model with minimal performance loss.

title: Superhero Wordle
description: An interactive arcade-style word-guessing game where players guess superhero names, use hints strategically, and compete on a leaderboard.

title: Budget-Friendly Trip Planner
description: Developed a cross-platform app to help users plan budget-friendly trips with optimized routes, attractions, and free activities. Integrated OpenAI API for smart suggestions and Firebase for real-time updates, improving planning efficiency by 40% and reducing travel costs by 25%.

title: Predictive Analytics for Vacant Buildings & Crime Trends
description: Processed and analyzed 8+ million crime records using SQL and Pandas, uncovering key spatial and temporal crime patterns linked to vacant buildings.

title: VisiSolve
description: VisiSolve employs image processing and ML techniques to recognize handwritten mathematical equations. This project aims to overcome the challenges associated with interpreting handwritten symbols through a series of preprocessing steps and neural network evaluations.
